declared: 2 October 2026, before any optical-density, biovolume or cell-count value of a small- or large-selected lineage was decoded
inspected_before_declaration: Dryad and Zenodo metadata; the archive member list and tabular headers; the authors' README and R scripts; the publication abstract and methods; R object structure (column names, types, lengths) and design factors, plates, wells and sampling times. No outcome value of any lineage, figure, photograph or fitted-result object had been opened.
units: Whole lineages: 10 small-selected, 10 control and 10 large-selected Dunaliella tertiolecta lineages
inspection_permitted_before_protocol_fre: All outcome columns of the 10 control lineages, in both growth experiments
Microscopy cell-size measurements of all 30 lineages (the size coordinate, a predictor)
The authors' biovolume-to-count calibration object, which is fitted to separate calibration cultures
gated_until_protocol_freeze: OD_BC, OD_BC_man, ODraw, OD_BC_middle, CellsUL and BiovolUL of every small- and large-selected lineage in 'All raw data.RData' and 'AllData across shelves.RData'
never_used_as_inputs: The authors' fitted-result objects (Fits/*.RData, SummaryData fits, All stats.RData), result figures and photographs
scope: Control lineages are development data in both folds, so inspecting them cannot leak an evaluation outcome. Each fold's forecasts must use only its development lineages. A protocol fixing the endpoints, estimators, models and scores will be committed before any gated value is decoded.
